name: Meitei Language Library Data Registry
description: Registry and governance specification for authentic Meitei (Manipuri) language datasets, defining stable ID conventions, validation rules, partition guarantees, and provenance requirements.

governance.no_fabrication_rule: No lexical records, senses, or citations shall be algorithmically fabricated or hallucinated. All core records require authentic attestation or native-speaker verification.

dataset_partitioning.core_lexicon: Restricted exclusively to SOURCE_ATTESTED and VERIFIED entries.
dataset_partitioning.candidate_lexicon: Reserved for UNVERIFIED, COMMUNITY_SUBMITTED, AI_CANDIDATE, CITATION_MISMATCH, and REJECTED entries awaiting editorial vetting.

sources.description: Stable 6-digit zero-padded numeric identifier for bibliographic sources.

lexical_entries.description: Stable 7-digit zero-padded numeric identifier for primary lexical entries.

senses.description: Stable 7-digit zero-padded numeric identifier for lexical senses.

variants.description: Stable 7-digit zero-padded numeric identifier for spelling and orthographic variants.

translation_glosses.description: Stable 7-digit zero-padded numeric identifier for cross-lingual translation glosses.

status_definitions.SOURCE_ATTESTED: Directly attested in a cataloged bibliographic source (Puya, royal chronicle, published dictionary, or critical edition) with an exact citation locator.
status_definitions.VERIFIED: Attested and independently confirmed by qualified native speakers or linguists adhering to standard orthography.
status_definitions.COMMUNITY_SUBMITTED: Contributed by community speakers or field contributors; pending editorial review and verification.
status_definitions.UNVERIFIED: Ingested from raw texts or provisional notes; unvetted.
status_definitions.AI_CANDIDATE: Generated or proposed by computational language models; quarantined in candidate_lexicon until peer-reviewed against primary sources.
status_definitions.CITATION_MISMATCH: Flagged during audit because cited source text, folio, or page does not corroborate the recorded meaning or spelling.
status_definitions.REJECTED: Reviewed and formally rejected due to factual error, spurious attribution, or uncorrectable defect.

core_lexicon.description: Authoritative lexical entries meeting SOURCE_ATTESTED or VERIFIED standards.

variants.description: Historical, regional, and orthographic spelling variants mapped to parent entries.

candidate_lexicon.description: Quarantine ledger for community submissions, unverified entries, and AI candidates.

sources.description: Catalog of authentic manuscripts, historical puyas, published lexicons, and fieldwork sessions.

glosses.description: Cross-lingual translation glosses linked to entries and senses.
